'''October 2000 Rochester tournament (21 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Millennium Games and Hobbies, Rochester, NY on 21 October 2000. [[Charles Clarkson]] won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1386">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-rochester-ny-10-21-2000d1386/ rochester-ny-10-21-2000], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-rochester-ny-10-21-2000d1386/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Millennium Games and Hobbies, Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Charles Clarkson]]
